headline: 5 Boring Utility Stocks That Just Keep Paying
summary: Some utilities have mailed unbroken dividend checks for seven straight decades, and a few on this list are quietly positioned to accelerate payouts just as data center demand rewrites their growth outlook.

headline: NextEra on track to close Dominion merger by late 2027, executives say
summary: The Virginia State Corporation Commission has scheduled the first public hearing on the proposal for this November. Separately, NextEra is also working to sign final agreements with the U.S. and Japan for 9.5 GW of gas-fired “hubs” in Texas and Pennsylvania.
